stage.name: Chocolate Street
stage.description:
The Summit of Nations is over, and Pathfinders that have not left with the Guide remain in Laterano, trying to restore faith there in their own way. They have caused a disturbance in the commercial area of the Stevonus district, and the Notarial Hall has requested help from Rhodes Island.
<Special Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<'Gelato Stop'>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, restores SP of surrounding allies

pathfinder_legionarius_prefect.name: Pathfinder Legionarius Prefect
pathfinder_legionarius_prefect.flavourText: A powerful warrior who has flocked to the Guide, inspired by his philosophy. Fights to bring the common goal of the Pathfinders to fruition.

pathfinder_sagittarius_prefect.name: Pathfinder Sagittarius Prefect
pathfinder_sagittarius_prefect.flavourText: An elite warrior proficient at using guns in long-range combat. Their attacks are precise, and especially deadly when loaded with special ammunition.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, ATK increases. Ammo capacity: 1

pathfinder_legionarius.name: Pathfinder Legionarius
pathfinder_legionarius.flavourText: A warrior who has flocked to the Guide, inspired by his philosophy. Fights to bring the common goal of the Pathfinders to fruition.

pathfinder_artifex_prefect.name: Pathfinder Artifex Prefect
pathfinder_artifex_prefect.flavourText: A caster employing unusual Originium Arts. Able to extract energy from special Arts Units to inflict horrific devastation.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks inflict Burn. Ammo capacity: 1

pathfinder_sagittarius.name: Pathfinder Sagittarius
pathfinder_sagittarius.flavourText: A warrior proficient at using guns in long-range combat. Their attacks are precise, and especially deadly when loaded with special ammunition.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, ATK increases. Ammo capacity: 1

pathfinder_veles_prefect.name: Pathfinder Veles Prefect
pathfinder_veles_prefect.flavourText: An elite warrior who specializes in dropping into battle from the skies. In addition to defeating their enemies, they will also destroy their supplies in the blink of an eye, blowing the battle wide open.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
Prioritizes attacking 'Gelato Stops'. Deals additional Arts Damage to 'Gelato Stops'.

pathfinder_veles.name: Pathfinder Veles
pathfinder_veles.flavourText: A warrior who specializes in dropping into battle from the skies. They take greater pleasure from seeing their foes flustered by the loss of their supplies than actually defeating them.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.
Prioritizes attacking 'Gelato Stops'. Deals additional Arts Damage to 'Gelato Stops'.

pathfinder_artifex.name: Pathfinder Artifex
pathfinder_artifex.flavourText: A caster employing unusual Originium Arts. Able to extract energy from special Arts Units to inflict tremendous devastation.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks inflict Burn. Ammo capacity: 1

snack_cart.name: Snack Cart
snack_cart.flavourText: A small cart that automatically tracks its delivery target. Of course, you will be able to help yourself to its contents – if you survive the explosion.
abilities: Detonates when blocked, inflicting Arts damage and Burn to all nearby targets
Explosion deals a large amount of Arts damage to nearby 'Gelato Stops'

luscious_snack_cart.name: Luscious Snack Cart
luscious_snack_cart.flavourText: A small cart that automatically tracks its delivery target. Of course, you will be able to help yourself to its contents – if you survive the massive explosion.
abilities: Detonates when blocked, inflicting Arts damage and Burn to all nearby targets
Explosion deals a large amount of Arts damage to nearby 'Gelato Stops'

pathfinder_ballistarius_prefect.name: Pathfinder Ballistarius Prefect
pathfinder_ballistarius_prefect.flavourText: A stalwart warrior who rushes forward on the front lines, firing shells capable of inflicting widespread destruction. By virtue of their physique, they can withstand the recoil from their cannons, and are proficient in close combat even without their weapons. Extremely reliable.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal Splash Damage. Ammo capacity: 2
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

renowned_pathfinder_dessert_vendor.name: Renowned Pathfinder Dessert Vendor
renowned_pathfinder_dessert_vendor.flavourText: Seems to be an ordinary street vendor. However, their carts are likely loaded with more than just snacks. Those who anger them will soon learn the true meaning of fear.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, periodically summons a <Luscious Snack Cart>. Ammo capacity: 3
Deals significantly increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

pathfinder_ballistarius.name: Pathfinder Ballistarius
pathfinder_ballistarius.flavourText: A stalwart warrior who stands on the front lines, firing shells capable of inflicting widespread destruction. By virtue of their physique, they can withstand the recoil from their cannons, as well as hold their own in close combat even without their weapons. Extremely reliable.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal Splash Damage. Ammo capacity: 2
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

pathfinder_dessert_vendor.name: Pathfinder Dessert Vendor
pathfinder_dessert_vendor.flavourText: Seems to be an ordinary street vendor. However, their carts are likely loaded with more than just snacks. Anger them at your own peril.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, periodically summons a <Snack Cart>. Ammo capacity: 3
Deals significantly increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

pathfinder_nuncio.name: Pathfinder Nuncio
pathfinder_nuncio.flavourText: A warrior who has taken the initiative to step up to the role of Nuncio within the Pathfinders. Strong and agile, these warriors employ the experience they've gained in their work and prefer to fight by sealing off their opponents' moves.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and prevent the target from attacking or healing for a period of time. Ammo Capacity: 1
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

oren_legatus.name: Oren, Legatus
oren_legatus.flavourText: The Legatus who stands head and shoulders above the rest, acting on his own principles. Preferring hit-and-run tactics to direct confrontations, he tries to deceive his opponents by sealing off their moves.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and prevent the target from attacking or healing for a period of time. Ammo Capacity: 1
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

bloodblade.name: Bloodblade
bloodblade.flavourText: Blood that bows to the will of the Blood Knight, re-animating and coagulating into the shape of a sharp blade.
abilities: After coming into contact with the <Blood Knight>, disappears and restores a certain amount of the <Blood Knight's> HP
